title: Shungiku Tacos with Charred Veggies
description: A delicious and healthy twist on traditional tacos, featuring shungiku as the main ingredient and a variety of charred vegetables.
instructions: Brush shungiku with a little oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill shungiku for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Meanwhile, grill the bell peppers, zucchini, and onions for 3-4 minutes per side, or until charred.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by placing a few shungiku leaves on each tortilla, followed by some charred vegetables, avocado, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Sprinkle cumin and chili powder on top for extra flavor.
